heading.en: Millions of sperm, one egg a month

hook.en: A man makes millions of sperm every day, but a woman releases usually one egg a month. The difference begins in the way gametes are made.
hook.kn: ಪುರುಷ ಪ್ರತಿದಿನ ಲಕ್ಷಾಂತರ ವೀರ್ಯಾಣುಗಳನ್ನು ತಯಾರಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ, ಆದರೆ ಸ್ತ್ರೀ ತಿಂಗಳಿಗೆ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯವಾಗಿ ಒಂದು ಅಂಡಾಣು ಬಿಡುಗಡೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾಳೆ.

body.en: Spermatogenesis begins at puberty. Spermatogonia (2n = 46) multiply by mitosis; some become primary spermatocytes (46), which complete meiosis I to form two secondary spermatocytes (23 each). Meiosis II gives four spermatids (23). Spermatids change into spermatozoa by spermiogenesis, and their release from the tubules is spermiation. GnRH from the hypothalamus raises LH, which acts on Leydig cells, and FSH, which acts on Sertoli cells. A sperm has a head with an acrosome, a neck, a middle piece packed with mitochondria, and a tail.
body.kn: ವೀರ್ಯಾಣು ಜನನ ಪ್ರೌಢಾವಸ್ಥೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಆರಂಭವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಒಂದು ಪ್ರಾಥಮಿಕ ವೀರ್ಯಕೋಶದಿಂದ ಅರೆವಿದಳನದ ಮೂಲಕ ನಾಲ್ಕು ಸ್ಪರ್ಮಟಿಡ್‌ಗಳು ಉಂಟಾಗಿ ವೀರ್ಯಾಣುಗಳಾಗುತ್ತವೆ. LH ಲೇಡಿಗ್ ಕೋಶಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ, FSH ಸೆರ್ಟೋಲಿ ಕೋಶಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ಕಾರ್ಯ ಮಾಡುತ್ತವೆ.

points.en: LH → Leydig cells; FSH → Sertoli cells

title.en: Board: spermatogenesis and oogenesis side by side

say.en: Spermatogonia multiply by mitosis. A primary spermatocyte completes meiosis one into two secondary spermatocytes, then meiosis two into four spermatids, which become sperms.
Oogonia form before birth. Primary oocytes stay arrested in prophase one; meiosis one is unequal and gives a secondary oocyte and a polar body; meiosis two finishes only when a sperm enters.
So one primary spermatocyte gives four sperms, but one primary oocyte gives only one ovum.
A sperm has a head with the nucleus and a cap called the acrosome, a short neck, a middle piece packed with mitochondria for energy, and a tail.
GnRH from the hypothalamus raises LH, which acts on Leydig cells, and FSH, which acts on Sertoli cells and helps spermiogenesis.

body.en: Oogenesis begins during foetal life, when about two million oogonia form in each ovary; no more are added after birth. They enter meiosis I and stay arrested in prophase I as primary oocytes inside primary follicles. Many degenerate; at puberty only 60,000–80,000 primary follicles remain in each ovary. In a tertiary follicle the primary oocyte completes meiosis I unequally, forming a large haploid secondary oocyte and a tiny first polar body. The Graafian follicle ruptures to release the secondary oocyte (ovulation). Meiosis II is completed only when a sperm enters, giving the ovum and a second polar body.
body.kn: ಅಂಡಾಣು ಜನನ ಭ್ರೂಣಾವಸ್ಥೆಯಲ್ಲೇ ಆರಂಭವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಪ್ರಾಥಮಿಕ ಅಂಡಕೋಶಗಳು ಮೊದಲ ಅರೆವಿದಳನದ ಪ್ರೊಫೇಸ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಲ್ಲುತ್ತವೆ. ಅಂಡೋತ್ಸರ್ಗದಲ್ಲಿ ದ್ವಿತೀಯ ಅಂಡಕೋಶ ಬಿಡುಗಡೆಯಾಗುತ್ತದೆ; ವೀರ್ಯಾಣು ಪ್ರವೇಶಿಸಿದಾಗ ಮಾತ್ರ ಎರಡನೇ ಅರೆವಿದಳನ ಮುಗಿಯುತ್ತದೆ.

problem.en: How many sperms are formed from 20 primary spermatocytes, and how many ova from 20 primary oocytes?

steps.en: Each primary spermatocyte gives 2 secondary spermatocytes and then 4 spermatids, which become 4 sperms: 20 × 4 = 80.
Each primary oocyte divides unequally: one large cell and polar bodies at each division, so only one ovum forms: 20 × 1 = 20.

problem.en: How many chromosomes are present in a human (a) spermatogonium, (b) secondary spermatocyte, (c) first polar body?

steps.en: Meiosis I halves the number, so a secondary spermatocyte has 23.
The first polar body is also formed in meiosis I, so it has 23.
